title: Ramayana: Rise Of Global Audience?
text:
Ramayana: Rise Of Global Audience? - The Times of India toi Sign In Ramayana: Rise Of Global Audience?
 Neeraj Kaushal 
 Nov 18, 2026, 20:41 IST IST 
 Like the latest big release, Indian films’ overseas revenues are thanks mostly to diaspora. Real world beaters will need to attract viewers, especially in West & China, with no connection to India
2026 may go down as the year Indian cinema began looking beyond the diaspora, for international audiences. But, will it also be the year those ambitions turn into reality? That may require more than divine intervention. Several major releases this year, including Dhurandhar and Jailer 2, have done well overseas, but their audiences have remained overwhelmingly Indian-origin. Among viewers with no connection to India, they have barely registered.
